result_event.result: [{"item":"①","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.answers.q2_moat.verdict_values.moat.threats","reason":"事實表負向的競爭／上下游條目（end_markets#1、competitive_share_entrants#2、regulatory_antitrust#1、substitute_technology#1、geo_supply_chain#0/#1）都已進 threats 或 R 項；customer_second_source 為 not_applicable，沒有漏接。"},{"item":"②","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.answers.q1_business.verdict_values.industry.sd_verdict_source","reason":"供給可逆性高已明寫，並接進 Bear 機率（30%）與 Base 終端 12 倍；bundle 內未見未被引用的 supply_demand_durability 負向 finding。"},{"item":"③","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.counter_evidence.contradictions","reason":"關稅回扣（reg_tariff_export#0-2）進 R4 與 triggers #6，反壟斷與 DOJ／OIG 進 R5，通路與 ICHRA（channel_business_model_shift#1）進產業態勢條目，補貼與資格審查進 R2，沒有被晾著的軸。"},{"item":"④","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.decision_inputs.wait_for_price_condition","reason":"裁決為觀望，wait_for_price=true 且條件可驗（2027-02 財測、開年會員、全年 MLR）；分母爭議（1.94／2.45／1.26 美元）已逐項攤開並對照 UBS 與共識，沒有矛盾。"},{"item":"⑤","light":"🟡","judgment_path":"$.answers.q6_how_wrong","reason":"只有 unprofitable_nrr_rule40_band 查無（NRR 對保險承保商不切題，查詢詞套用了 SaaS 同業帶），屬非核心軸；判斷對 financial_capital_credit_cycle 與同業本益比的缺口有交代為資料缺口，燈號以程式為準。"},{"item":"⑥","light":"🟡","judgment_path":"$.scenario_inputs.eps.base","reason":"formula_note 有算式、15%＝25%×60% 對得上、與共識 CAGR 21% 的缺口在 q3 有處理，Bull／Base／Bear 價差實質，Bull 99.2、Bear 12.8、EV +55.6% 與 scenario_meta 一致；但 Base 2027 EPS 2.35 高於共識 2.22 與管理層「利潤率逾 5%」對應的 2.25，卻寫營業利益率略低於 5%，內部口徑未對齊，不改裁決方向。"},{"item":"⑦","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.answers.q1_business.fact_refs","reason":"營運指標引用的是 Q3 2026（2026-09-30，公告 2026-11-05）的營收、營業利益、MLR、SG&A、會員與九個月 FCF 3,478.9M，數字與事實表一致；指引區間也是 11-05 最新版，沒有更舊的指標。"},{"item":"⑧","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.counter_evidence.contradictions","reason":"前份非空且有變動的欄位是 signal（C→B，cause=新證據）、ma（方法變動）、price_at_dd（價格變動），另有期望報酬拆解的程式歸因，都有帶 cause 的條目；其餘 drift_watch 欄前份為空，不計。"}]
